title: THE DEEP OCEAN VENTS
narration_text: Along the ocean floor's volcanic fissures, hydrothermal vents spew mineral-dense fluids at temperatures exceeding four hundred degrees Celsius. In this pitch-black abyss, survival seems impossible. Yet, life thrives. Specialized bacteria perform chemosynthesis, converting toxic hydrogen sulfide into organic energy without a single ray of sunlight. This chemical engine powers an entire deep-sea food web, proving that life can flourish in the most extreme environments in the universe.
